title: Can Can Bunny Premiere 2
native_title: きゃんきゃんバニー プルミエール２
overview:
A romance adventure game. A lonely young man who longs for a girlfriend is startled by an explosion in his home, and in his room he finds the seven little Gods of Luck along with the green-haired goddess Swatty. She gives him the Star of Guidance, and the next day, when he meets a cute girl, the star begins to glow.

Get to know a cast of girls around town and choose your words and actions carefully to win one of them over.

- A second disc, the Himekuri Calendar, where the navigators Swatty and Sawady greet you with a different message each day
- Supports the Shuttle Mouse and the Sega Multi Controller
